what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Iceland, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters stayed between 3401 and 3700 from 2023 to 2025.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Iceland list volcanic activity.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Iceland.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.
IDMC's data for Iceland starts in 2017.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 104 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Iceland.
